meta.note: Hidden backend toolkit only. Never store Suspicion, Protection, Political Cost, Church favour, Zeal, Greed, writs or sentence records on a Foundry actor. Witch hunters use no magic and no Witch-Sight.

order.name: The Mercy of Ash
order.name_reason: They call burning a mercy, which echoes the Ashen Coast mercy sacrifices in lore/era_1670.json.
order.rivals: Holy Judges (who handle heresy, knights and nobles)
order.later_npc: A magic-using female witch hunter may come later as a special NPC only.

methods.false_positives: Pricking, cold-water and heat tests can look damning on an innocent woman. They never prove magic. The GM treats a suggestive result as a prompt, not a verdict.
methods.salt_note: Salt is already a Veil bane (Daughters of the Drowned Moon). A placeholder: it may sting or fizz on Veil-touched flesh, but that is still not proof on its own.

detection.roll: Inspect skill + d100 + modifier; success on 100 or more. Ties and automatic cases skip the contest. Concealment and composure are opposed by the target's Willpower or Deceive (tie goes to the defender).

corruption.50: found only by a stripping exam (automatic if they undress her)
corruption.75: Inspect +0 at a glance; -20 if concealed with gloves, collar or paint, but concealment fails on close contact

sigils.I: Inspect -30 at a glance; automatic on stripping or pricking
sigils.II: Inspect -15 at a glance; automatic on stripping
sigils.Branded: automatic, and Lore: Witchcraft names her school

thresholds.prompt: An informer tails her and prices rise.
She is summoned and her lodgings searched. A hunter may Interrogate her.
A bounty is posted and a hunting party is sent.
An arrest attempt and a full exam are in play. A sentence, if any, is the GM's to choose from the menu.

suspicion.new_region: A new region starts at 0. If she already has a bounty (Suspicion 60 or more in another region), the new region starts at 10 (placeholder spillover). Fleeing still helps.

levels.1: a guild, merchant house or abbot

protection.rule: Hunters can act freely only when their Authority is at least her Protection. Authority is 1 for a Sworn Hunter or Hunt-Sergeant, 2 for a Witchfinder-Captain, 3 for the Witchfinder General. Informers and Trackers have Authority 0.

political_cost.applies_when: The hunters act against a protected woman without Authority >= Protection, or without a Sealed Writ that covers her.

church_writ.name: Church Writ
church_writ.effect: Ordinary license to investigate and arrest Veil crimes. It does not override Protection.

sealed_writ.name: Sealed Writ
sealed_writ.effect: Legal assassination of a named target. Authority is treated as enough to act on that target. Church-favour cost for the act is waived; the patron may still become an enemy if the king was not the patron.

tolerance_tithe.name: Tolerance Tithe
tolerance_tithe.note: A neutral city in wartime may tolerate a mage and extort her resources rather than kill her.

bribe.formula: accept if (Greed + min(40, offer_gold // 5)) >= Zeal, after a corrupt hunter treats Zeal as 20 lower for this check
bribe.fanatic: Zeal >= 80: always refuses, and the offer raises Suspicion by failed_bribe (15) if it was made
bribe.failed_non_fanatic: A refused bribe still raises Suspicion by failed_bribe (15) unless the hunter is corrupt and is only holding out for more gold

sentences.chooser: The GM picks from the menu. default_lean is only a helper.

menu.name: Fine or ransom
menu.gold: placeholder: 50 x (Protection + 1), or a named ransom

menu.name: Confinement, branding or mutilation
menu.mutilation_note: Tongue or hands may be taken to end casting. Severe; GM's call.

menu.name: Sale
menu.note: Sold to the galleys or a noble house. The character leaves play pending the GM.

menu.name: Execution
menu.note: Carried out by ordinary means after the sentence. Not an instant-kill power and not a Breath miracle.

holy_judge.status: A vocation inside the Crusader Knight order, not a separate starting class.

interrogate.name: Interrogate
interrogate.roll: Perception + Willpower + d100 vs the higher of Willpower or Deceive + d100
interrogate.divine_clarity: +10 against lies if the Judge has Divine Clarity
interrogate.passive_flavour: If Breath has already triggered randomly near a possessed person or demon, the Judge may sense the thing inside them. That remains passive.

final_verdict.becomes: Legal authority to sentence and to have a sentence carried out by ordinary means. No instant-kill power.
final_verdict.requires: A legal finding (evidence, confession, or a completed exam), not a magical reading of sin.

breath.rule: Passive and random only. It may answer a pure Crusader or Judge against corrupted beasts, demons, ghosts, spirits and possessed humans only. Never against ordinary sinners, and never against an un-possessed sorceress.
